APPENDIX A 
1 User Guide Documentation 
 
Figure 64 Homepage 
Along the top you can see two values, on the left is your streak, and on the right 
is your total gems. To increase these values, you need to complete lessons daily, 
and get questions within lessons correct respectively.  
Note: your streak will return to 0, if you do not return within 48 hours. 
You can select a subject to learn from the options highlighted in the centre of 
the page. 
You may use the navigation bar along the bottom of the page to go to the 
following (1) Homepage, (2) Spaced-Repetition page, (3) Leader Board page, 
(4) Achievements page, (5) sign-out.
